title: Multi-Aspect 4K Export
description: Renders the primary video plus 4K upscale and all three aspect variants (9:16, 16:9, 1:1). The base render is 720×1280, then 4K variant upscales to 3840×2160. Also generates poster thumbnail and contact sheet.
